By this I mean the main ‘Newbie’ instructor doesn’t clearly state side changes, arm changes, or the length of holds before switching. So I find myself always breaking form with my neck to make sure I can see the app in order to switch sides (left to right, up to down etc.). There are instructors who do this very clearly but as I said if I pick these sessions my daily tracker doesn’t register the workout. I know I worked out 7 days in a row but the tracker states I didn’t work out. The OCD in me finds this frustrating. I am athletic but due to life and injuries I haven’t worked out in years, so I want to get in shape in a gentle healthy way. I do not want to re-injure myself so form is very important. And as I have to keep turning my head towards the app my neck can’t be in the correct position most of the time. Also often if I listen to the instructions they don’t match what she is doing. I find this frustrating. I would just pick a different instructor but as I said then the daily tracker doesn’t show an accurate account of workout days. So, what I am saying is I don’t think I will be using this app past the 28 days challenge. Maybe I am not understanding how the app works. But this is what I am experiencing and I would have wanted to know prior to signing up. Because my neck (as many people) is healthy but fragile and if I don’t have it correctly place it is hard to avoid possibly re-injuring it. Hope someone finds this helpful.
